Validates every value (unknown keys are errors). definitions.WorkerPoolSpec and definitions.TrustPolicySpec are generated from api/crds by `go test ./charts/cucina/tests/chart -update` (a test fails when they are stale). README.md's values table is generated from the descriptions here.

claimMappings.description: ClaimMappings derive the principal from the claims.

groups.description: Groups yields a list of group strings.

subject.description:
Subject is the stable principal, e.g. `'google:' + claims.sub` or
`'github:' + claims.repository_id + ':' + claims.workflow`. Never key on email.

claimValidationRules.description: ClaimValidationRules are CEL expressions over `claims`; all must be true.

items.description: ClaimValidationRule is a CEL expression over `claims` that must evaluate to true.

expression.description: Expression is CEL, e.g. `claims.hd in ['example.com'] && string(claims.email_verified) == 'true'`.

message.description: Message is returned (and audited) when the rule is false.

disabled.description: Disabled keeps the object but ignores it.

grants.description:
Grants are evaluated independently; the result is their union. A grant with a CEL
condition applies only when the condition is true (fail closed).

items.description: Grant gives verbs on instance names.

condition.description: Condition is an optional CEL expression over `claims`, `subject` and `groups`.

instanceNames.description: InstanceNames the verbs apply to; "*" = every configured instance name.

maxTTL.description: MaxTTL caps the JWT lifetime for this grant (default and maximum 15m for humans and CI).

name.description: Name labels the grant in audit logs.

verbs.description: Verbs: cas-read, cas-write, ac-read, ac-write, execute, admin.

groupLookup.description:
GroupLookup optionally resolves group membership at every exchange (cached 5–10 min),
e.g. Google Cloud Identity searchDirectGroups (R-AUTH-2/-5).

issuer.description: Issuer of the external token (type oidc).

additionalIssuers.description: AdditionalIssuers lists extra accepted `iss` values (Google also emits "accounts.google.com").

audiences.description: Audiences accepted in `aud`; for GitHub the audience used only by Cucina ("cucina").

certificateAuthority.description: CertificateAuthority is a PEM bundle trusted for discovery/JWKS fetches (optional).

url.description: URL is the exact `iss` value (e.g. https://accounts.google.com, https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com).

login.description:
Login publishes interactive-login parameters in /.well-known/cucina-configuration so
`cucinactl login <url>` needs no other config (R-AUTH-1, R-AUTH-5).

clientID.description:
ClientID of the OAuth2 "Desktop app" client; ClientSecret is non-confidential by design
(Google desktop clients) and is shipped in the discovery document.

hostedDomainHint.description: HostedDomainHint is passed as `hd` (a hint only; trust comes from claimValidationRules).

name.description: Name of the identity provider shown by the CLI ("google", "github", …).

redirectPorts.description: RedirectPorts restricts loopback ports for providers that need registered ports (empty = any).

scopes.description: Scopes requested; default [openid, email, profile] (+ offline_access for non-Google).

requireUniqueJTI.description: RequireUniqueJTI enables the jti replay cache for this issuer (GitHub, R-AUTH-7).

breakGlass.description: Break-glass marks the bootstrap admin account generated by `helm install` (R-AUTH-12).

name.description: Name is the principal name (subject becomes `sa:<name>`).

subjectTokenType.description:
SubjectTokenType is the RFC 8693 subject_token_type this policy accepts:
"urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token" (default) or "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt"
(GitHub Actions).

type.description:
Type is "oidc" (default) for external identity providers or "serviceAccount" for opt-in
long-lived keys (R-AUTH-10), which are exchanged at the STS like any other subject token.

capacity.description: Capacity bounds the pool. minRunning > 0 means standing cost and is opt-in.

max.description: Max is the maximum number of VMs. 0 disables the pool: queued work is failed fast (R-RE-2).

minRunning.description: MinRunning workers kept alive even when idle. Default 0 (zero idle cost).

dailyInstanceHourCap.description:
DailyInstanceHourCap stops launching new instances once the pool consumed this
many instance-hours since 00:00 UTC (R-SCALE-7). Unset = no cap.

associatePublicIP.description: AssociatePublicIP gives workers a public IPv4 — only when no other egress path exists.

capacityType.description: CapacityType: on-demand (default) or spot (SHOULD; falls back to on-demand when spotFallback).

dataVolume.description:
DataVolume is an extra ephemeral gp3 volume for L1/filePool when the type has no
instance store (DeleteOnTermination always true).

initializationRateMiBps.description: InitializationRateMiBps is the per-launch volume initialization rate (0 = off, R-POOL-2 SHOULD).

extraTags.description: ExtraTags are added to every resource (e.g. the campaign tags).

fastLaunch.description: FastLaunch applies to Windows pools: pre-provisioned snapshots (user-approved standing cost).

launchTemplateID.description: LaunchTemplateID of the small, cheap prep instance type; created by the controller when empty.

maxParallelLaunches.description: MaxParallelLaunches during snapshot preparation (within AWS limits).

targetCount.description: TargetCount of pre-provisioned snapshots; default = capacity.max.

instanceProfile.description: InstanceProfile (name) with SSM core and own-pool parameter read, no EC2 permissions.

instanceTypes.description: InstanceTypes is the ordered preference list, e.g. [c8i.8xlarge, c7i.8xlarge, c7a.8xlarge].

rootVolume.description: RootVolume: smallest that fits; gp3 baseline.

initializationRateMiBps.description: InitializationRateMiBps is the per-launch volume initialization rate (0 = off, R-POOL-2 SHOULD).

spotFallback.description: SpotFallback allows on-demand launches when spot capacity is unavailable.

subnetIDs.description: SubnetIDs in preference order; a single AZ by default (R-DATA-4).

floorSchedule.description: FloorSchedule raises minRunning during windows (opt-in standing cost, R-SCALE-7).

items.description: FloorWindow raises the pool floor during a recurring window (UTC cron-like).

start.description: Start and End are "HH:MM" in UTC.

image.description: Image selects the AMI or Tart image. Changing it starts a new pool generation (R-OPS-2).

ami.description: AMI is an explicit AMI ID (EC2).

amiSelector.description: AMISelector picks the newest AMI owned by the account whose tags match (EC2).

reference.description:
Reference is the OCI image reference of the Tart image (Tart), e.g.
ghcr.io/sloper-ai/cucina-worker-macos:27.0-0.1.0.

version.description:
Version is the image version label; a change starts a new generation (R-POOL-8).
Defaults to the resolved image's cucina:image-version tag.

instanceNames.description:
InstanceNames lists the Buildbarn instance names (tenants) this pool serves.
Empty means every configured instance name.

paused.description: Paused cordons the pool: no new launches; running workers finish and idle out.

platform.description:
Platform names an entry of platforms/pools.json (shipped in the controller and the
chart), e.g. "linux-x86-64", "linux-aarch64", "windows-x86-64", "macos-arm64-xcode27.0".
The entry supplies the runners and their exact REAPI platform properties.

provider.description: Provider is "ec2" or "tart" and must match the platform's provider.

rollout.description:
Rollout controls replacement of old-generation workers: "lazy" (default) replaces
them when idle, "eager" drains and replaces them immediately.

sizeClass.description:
SizeClass names a size class of the platform (pools differing only in machine
size are size classes of one platform). Each platform in pools.json declares
its size classes; "default" always exists.

cpu.description: CPU and memory override the host-derived defaults ((cores-2)/slots, (RAM-8GB)/slots).

maxAge.description: MaxAge: VMs older than this are re-cloned from the golden image (default 168h).

suspendable.description: Suspendable evaluates `tart suspend` as the "off" state (R-MAC-3 SHOULD).

timers.description:
Timers default per platform: idle 5 m (EC2 Linux) / 10 m (EC2 Windows, macOS);
startup 5 m (Linux, macOS) / 15 m (Windows); drain 30 m.

drainTimeout.description: DrainTimeout: after this long a draining VM is stopped even if actions still run.

idleTimeout.description: IdleTimeout: a VM idle this long (with an empty queue) is drained and stopped (R-SCALE-3).

startupTimeout.description: StartupTimeout: a VM that has not registered by then is failed and replaced.

buildDirectory.description:
BuildDirectory selects the build directory mode (R-CACHE-3); auto picks FUSE (Linux),
WinFSP (Windows) and the measured choice on macOS.

concurrency.description: Concurrency is the number of execution slots of the pool's primary runner; default = vCPUs.

placement.description:
Placement: auto prefers instance-store NVMe, then an ephemeral gp3 volume, then memory
(EC2); the VM disk on macOS. "vm-disk" is Tart only.

sizeGiB.description: SizeGiB of the L1 CAS; default 40 on macOS, derived from the instance elsewhere.

runnerConcurrency.description:
RunnerConcurrency overrides slots per runner name (e.g. "qemu-s390x": 2). Emulated
runners default to a low concurrency documented in docs/sizing.md.

httpsOrigin.description: An HTTPS origin with an optional trailing slash; no userinfo, other path, query or fragment. Ports are 1–65535; IPv6 addresses use brackets.

tag.description: Informational; the digest is what is pulled.

platform.description: A platform catalog entry (internal/pools.Platform, parsed strictly by the controller).

pool.description: A WorkerPool: name, enabled, and the WorkerPool spec fields (api/v1alpha1).

size.description: Bytes of blocks of this store per shard.

includeServiceNames.description: Also request the in-cluster Service names (not with ACME).

enabled.description: Generate the break-glass admin key (bootstrap hook) and its TrustPolicy (R-AUTH-12).

keyRotationPublishLead.description: How long a new signing key is published before it signs (>= 10m).

rateLimitPerMinute.description: STS exchanges per minute per client.

authorizerTestVectors.description: Embed JMESPath test vectors in every authorizer; Buildbarn refuses to start if one fails.

actionCachePurgeBefore.description: Hide worker-produced action results completed before this RFC 3339 time (AC purge, R-CACHE-5).

existenceCacheDuration.description: FindMissingBlobs existence-cache TTL (<= 3600s; must stay below storage retention).

maximumTotalTreeSizeBytes.description: completenessChecking limit, above the largest toolchain Tree (R-DATA-2).

decoderWindowSizeBytes.description: Largest client zstd window accepted (Bazel uses <= 8 MiB).

controllerIdentity.description: SPIFFE ID of the controller's BuildQueueState client certificate.

feedbackDrivenSizeClasses.description: Persist execution statistics in the ISCC (useful with several size classes).

averageObjectSize.description: Average object size per store, used to size the key-location maps.

keyLocationMapFactor.description: Key-location map entries per expected object (upstream: 2-10).

minimumEpochInterval.description: fsync interval of the persistent state (upstream: 300s).

clusterId.description: Installation ID (cucina:cluster tag on cloud resources); unique per installation. Default <namespace>-<release>.

accountId.description: AWS account of the instance identity documents; set at install time, never commit it.

extraTags.description: Tags added to every resource the controller creates.

queueFailAfter.description: Fail queued work of a pool without capacity after this long.

install.description: Apply the WorkerPool, MacHost and TrustPolicy CRDs from the controller image before every install and upgrade (cluster-scoped hook RBAC). false: the CRDs are managed elsewhere (use helm --skip-crds).

extraNames.description: Extra DNS names/IPs for the public certificate.

host.description: Public DNS name or IP of the remote-execution endpoint.

port.description: External port of the remote-execution endpoint.

host.description: Address Mac hosts use for the HostService. Default the enrollment host.

schedulerHost.description: Scheduler hostname/IP reachable from Mac sites; uses worker.schedulerPort. Default: explicit hosts.host, else the worker scheduler host. Does not change EC2 endpoints.

storageHost.description: Storage hostname/IP reachable from Mac sites; uses worker.storagePort. Default: explicit hosts.host, else the worker storage host. Does not change EC2 endpoints.

host.description: Host of the management API. Default endpoints.client.host.

port.description: External port of the management API.

aliases.description: Allowed HTTPS transport origins for the STS; discovery token/JWKS URLs may use them, but the canonical JWT issuer stays sts.url. Their hostname/IP SANs are included in STS certificates.

url.description: Issuer URL of Cucina JWTs (no trailing slash needed). Default https://<client.host>:<sts.port>.

enrollmentHost.description: Host of the enrollment API when it has its own load balancer.

enrollmentPort.description: External port of the enrollment API.

extraNames.description: Extra DNS names/IPs for the internal certificate.

host.description: Private IP or DNS name of the worker endpoint (VPC/Mac sites only).

schedulerHost.description: Host of the scheduler worker API when it has its own load balancer.

schedulerPort.description: External port of the scheduler worker API.

serverName.description: TLS server name workers verify. Default endpoints.worker.host.

storageHost.description: Host of the frontend worker listener when it has its own load balancer.

storagePort.description: External port of the frontend worker listener (CAS/AC/FSAC for workers and hosts).

api.description: Exposure of the STS and the management API (TLS by the pods).

annotations.description: Annotations of the client Service (e.g. AWS NLB settings).

backendServiceAnnotations.description: Annotations of the frontend ClusterIP Service an Ingress/Gateway uses (e.g. traefik.ingress.kubernetes.io/service.serversscheme: h2c).

parentRefs.description: Gateway API parentRefs of the GRPCRoute.

tlsSecretName.description: Secret with the certificate the Ingress presents.

type.description: How the remote-execution endpoint is exposed; Ingress/Gateway terminate TLS and reach the frontend over h2c.

worker.description: Exposure of the worker endpoint (mTLS needs L4 pass-through).

frontend.description: Frontend (stateless bb_storage) settings; null/empty = size profile.

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces <release>-<chart> as the prefix of every object name (max 40 characters).

global.description: Reserved by Helm for parent charts; unused.

enabled.description: pre-install/pre-upgrade bootstrap Job (CA, certificates, keys, JWKS, deny-list, break-glass key).

credentialSecret.description: Secret with the service-account key of the canaries (helm test and the controller's 5-minute loop); empty = the break-glass key.

enabled.description: pre-delete Job that drains and terminates every worker (R-OPS-3).

bbStorage.description: bb_storage image (frontend, storage shards), pinned by digest.

controller.description: cucina-controller image (controller, STS, hooks, helm test).

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy of every container.

sts.description: STS image; empty repository = the controller image.

instanceNames.description: Buildbarn instance names (tenants, R-RE-3); the first is the default. Lower-case path segments.

enabled.description: ScrapeConfigs using the leader's HTTP discovery for EC2 workers and Mac host/VM metrics relayed through HostService.

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in object names.

enabled.description: Restrict the in-cluster-only ports (storage gRPC, scheduler client and BuildQueueState).

metricsFrom.description: NetworkPolicy peers allowed to scrape metrics (empty = anyone).

controllerClientCertTTL.description: Lifetime of the controller's BuildQueueState client certificate.

existingCASecret.description: Existing Secret with ca.crt and ca.key; empty = <fullname>-ca created by the bootstrap hook.

extra.description: Additional platform catalog entries (schema of platforms/pools.json).

pools.description: WorkerPool objects (R-POOL-1): [{name, enabled, ...WorkerPool spec}]. See samples/pools.yaml.

sizeProfile.description: Size profile (files/profiles.yaml): small (single-node test), medium (default production), large. Per-component values override it.

mode.description: file: file-backed blocks on a filesystem PVC (local-path); block: raw volumeMode Block for the CAS (EBS CSI) plus a filesystem PVC.

size.description: Filesystem PVC size; empty = derived from the stores. Immutable after install.

stores.description: One size per store; blocks and key-location maps derive from it (R-CP-3).

supplementalGroups.description: Extra groups of the storage container (raw block devices).

internal.description: Certificate of the worker endpoint, the controller and the in-cluster mTLS listeners (must chain to Cucina's CA).

public.description: Certificate of the client endpoint and the STS.

refreshInterval.description: How often Buildbarn re-reads mounted certificates (rotation without restart).

serverCertificateDuration.description: Lifetime of chart-generated server certificates (renewed by the controller at 2/3).
